mapper.select: SELECT /* getLikeDtl */ R.TAGT_TYPE , R.TAGT_NUMB , COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , COALESCE(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO FROM ( SELECT #{tagtType} AS TAGT_TYPE , #{tagtNumb} AS TAGT_NUMB ) R LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_TYPE , L.TAGT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} GROUP BY L.TAGT_TYPE, L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON LC.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND LC.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_TYPE , L.TAGT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ) UL ON UL.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND UL.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB

SELECT /* getProfileStats */ TARGET.USER_NUMB , COALESCE(READSTATS.TOTAL_READ_BOOK_CNT, 0) AS TOTAL_READ_BOOK_CNT , COALESCE(FOLLOWINGSTATS.FOLLOWING_CNT, 0) AS FOLLOWING_CNT , COALESCE(FOLLOWERSTATS.FOLLOWER_CNT, 0) AS FOLLOWER_CNT , COALESCE(LIKESTATS.RECEIVED_LIKE_CNT, 0) AS RECEIVED_LIKE_CNT FROM ( SELECT #{userNumb} AS USER_NUMB ) TARGET LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REPORT.USER_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_READ_BOOK_CNT FROM TM_REPORT REPORT WHERE REPORT.REPT_STAT = #{reportStatDone} AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY REPORT.USER_NUMB ) READSTATS ON READSTATS.USER_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FOLLOW.USER_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS FOLLOWING_CNT FROM TB_FOLLOW FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOW.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY FOLLOW.USER_NUMB ) FOLLOWINGSTATS ON FOLLOWINGSTATS.USER_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS FOLLOWER_CNT FROM TB_FOLLOW FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY FOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB ) FOLLOWERSTATS ON FOLLOWERSTATS.USER_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REPORT.USER_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS RECEIVED_LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX LIKES INNER JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = LIKES.TAGT_NUMB WHERE LIKES.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY REPORT.USER_NUMB ) LIKESTATS ON LIKESTATS.USER_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getFollowingList */ U.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , U.INTR_CNTN , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS ME_YSNO , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN NULL ELSE FN_GET_FOLW_STAT(#{loginUserNumb}, U.USER_NUMB) END AS FOLLOW_STAT_NAME FROM TB_FOLLOW FL INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = FL.FLOW_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE FL.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , FL.REGI_DATE DESC , U.USER_NUMB DESC

SELECT /* getFollowerList */ U.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , U.INTR_CNTN , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS ME_YSNO , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN NULL ELSE FN_GET_FOLW_STAT(#{loginUserNumb}, U.USER_NUMB) END AS FOLLOW_STAT_NAME FROM TB_FOLLOW FL INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = FL.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE FL.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , FL.REGI_DATE DESC , U.USER_NUMB DESC
